description: Swaps the bitmap of an existing image element while keeping its frame, position and effects (batchUpdate replaceImage). The new picture comes from image_url or image_path with exactly the same validation/upload/cleanup rules as create_image. replace_method: center_inside (default — scales to fit inside the frame, keeping aspect) or center_crop (fills the frame, cropping the overflow).

image_object_id.description: The existing image element's object id (type "image" in list_slides).

image_path.description: Absolute local path of the new image (exactly one of image_url / image_path).

image_url.description: Public https URL of the new PNG/JPEG/GIF (exactly one of image_url / image_path).

presentation_id.description: The presentation id — the long id from the URL (docs.google.com/presentation/d/<presentationId>/edit) or from create_presentation output.

replace_method.description: How the new image fills the old frame (default center_inside).

name: replace_image
title: Replace an image
